name: B10-0137/2024 (S&D) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China to stop military pressure and threats against Taiwan. It says China misuses a 1971 United Nations resolution to claim Taiwan is part of China, which the resolution does not say. It asks the European Union to strengthen ties with Taiwan, support Taiwan's participation in international bodies, and prepare for a possible escalation. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament states positions and requests; no law changes and no decision is binding.
- It affects EU relations with China and Taiwan, and Taiwan's access to international bodies.
- Next, the text goes to EU institutions and the Chinese and Taiwanese authorities for their response.
